title: Grand Canyon West Rim including Skywalk and Lunch
blurb: Embark on a tour of one of Earth's most breathtaking destinations. Marvel at two of the canyon's most stunning overlooks and discover why it's celebrated as one of the Seven Natural Wonders of the World. For the adventurous, step onto the Skywalk for an exhilarating view of the canyon floor from 4,000 feet above. Enjoy a brief tour of an Indian Village and savor lunch at a charming Western Ranch that feels like a scene from a John Wayne movie!
